title: Wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- strap top -->
  <rect x='38' y='4' width='24' height='26' rx='5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <rect x='38' y='4' width='24' height='26' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#d98f4a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- strap holes -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2' fill='#7a3f0f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='2' fill='#7a3f0f'/>
  <!-- strap bottom -->
  <rect x='38' y='70' width='24' height='26' rx='5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <rect x='38' y='70' width='24' height='26' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#d98f4a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='20' height='9' rx='3' fill='#f0c040'/>
  <rect x='46' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- watch case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='#f0c040'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x='70' y='46' width='7' height='8' rx='2' fill='#d9a520'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='17' fill='#1e2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#4a6bb0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hour ticks -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='35' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#9fd0ff'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='61' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#9fd0ff'/>
  <rect x='35' y='48.5' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9fd0ff'/>
  <rect x='61' y='48.5' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9fd0ff'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x='49' y='40' width='2.5' height='11' rx='1.2' fill='#ffd86b'/>
  <rect x='50' y='49' width='10' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffd86b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ecd'/>
</svg>
